# Jiandong Ding Research Site

This is the personal research site of Jiandong Ding, Principal Algorithm Expert at Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd., Shanghai, China.

The site is organized around two research lines: Adaptive Recommendation under Change, and Auditable AI Retrieval and Interfaces. The homepage connects each line to representative mechanisms, evidence, limitations, and public resources. Earlier learning methods and industrial systems are described in a separate research-connections section.

The publication record is also browsable by three broad topics:

- LLM Agents: AI search, skill retrieval, NL2SQL evaluation, LLM serving systems, and capability governance.
- Recommender Systems: user reactivation, generative recommendation, Semantic-ID interface diagnostics, dynamic retrieval, behavior modeling, and trustworthy prediction.
- Data Mining: weak supervision, robust learning, text mining, analytics, field experiments, and earlier sequence-analysis work.

Primary human-readable pages:

- Home: https://jdding.github.io/
- Full publications: https://jdding.github.io/publications/
- Patents: https://jdding.github.io/patents/
- LLM Agents topic: https://jdding.github.io/topics/llm-agents/
- Recommender Systems topic: https://jdding.github.io/topics/recommender-systems/
- Data Mining topic: https://jdding.github.io/topics/data-mining/

Machine-readable resources:

- Research data: https://jdding.github.io/api/research.json
- Publications: https://jdding.github.io/api/publications.json
- Patents: https://jdding.github.io/api/patents.json
- Topics: https://jdding.github.io/api/topics.json
- Projects: https://jdding.github.io/api/projects.json
- Knowledge graph: https://jdding.github.io/api/knowledge-graph.json
- Machine resource index: https://jdding.github.io/sitemap-extended.xml

Publication records are grouped by year, with recent work first. Accepted, published, and preprint statuses are distinct. Preprint posting, acceptance, and formal publication dates have separate fields; an accepted paper's preprint date is not its journal or conference publication date. The API is the current source for per-paper status and relationships. Digest pages explain individual papers; pages without a research explanation are labeled Paper record. Patent records include patent number, status, year, applied area, source link, and inventor role.

For research collaboration, student research internships, invited talks, and general exchange, contact dingjiandong2@huawei.com.
